Schema: (domain TEXT PRIMARY KEY, policy_id TEXT NOT NULL, mode TEXT NOT NULL, mx_patterns TEXT NOT NULL, fetched_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, expires_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL).
